findings.severity: medium, before the admin goes live
findings.what: The JSON Admin API accepts a content type a cross-site page can send without a preflight ('text/plain; charset=application/json': readJson checks includes('application/json')) and checks no Origin; with the owner's Access cookie sent cross-site, a page elsewhere could cancel or refund. The screen's forms do check Origin.
findings.fix: readJson: the MIME essence must equal application/json; admin mutations require Origin = self or Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin (or a service token for the studio); Access cookie SameSite=Lax or Strict (runbook).

findings.severity: required before a real supplier adapter (3.1)
findings.what: After a supplier call that timed out (or failed in a way that may have created the order), the shipment is 'failed' and the cancellation treats the order as before the supplier: full refund, shipment canceled, no request to the supplier, which may still ship.
findings.fix: A 'failed' shipment whose last error may have reached the supplier (timeout, non-refusal) and supplier_error orders count as sent: ask the supplier by our order number first, or take the after-supplier path, or hold for a person.

findings.severity: required before a real refund adapter (2.5)
findings.what: A refund provider that can be asked (findRefund) but does not deduplicate: the same key at once ×5 → 5 refunds at the provider, 1 recorded. resume() asks find, gets nothing (the first call is in flight) and calls again; the lease check applies only to providers that cannot be asked.
findings.fix: As the invoice job: a claim younger than the lease is 'in_progress' (409) for every provider kind; only after the lease ask find, and call again only if the provider dedupes or find says none.

findings.what: (a) a tracking link with a malformed % escape from the supplier throws URIError in customerTrackingUrl: the customer's order API is 500 for that order for good; (b) the order page (and cart) show a generic 'לא הצלחנו לטעון את ההזמנה' without the error code the server sent.
findings.fix: try/catch around decodeURIComponent (malformed → number only); the order page and cart show message_he (with the code), like checkout.

findings.what: PII in logs through error text: a name or address inside an exception message (request.unhandled) or an invoice provider's error (config.refused) is logged as is; only emails and phones are masked. The natural paths are clean.
findings.fix: Log provider errors by code/status only, or scrub the order's own customer values (exact match) from any message before logging; keep the full text only in D1 (last_error, behind Access).

findings.what: A failed supplier submit writes no log row, and /healthz ignores failed shipments and supplier_error orders: with the production config today (cj refuses), every paid order fails at the supplier with 0 log rows and /healthz ok.
findings.fix: A structured error row on every failed submit (code only, ת38), and /healthz 'degraded' when a paid order has failed at the supplier for > N minutes or is supplier_error.

findings.severity: low (dormant: with the 60 s deadline a run must outlive the lease)
findings.what: claim_lost is silent when the takeover already recorded: the late answer of a lost invoice or credit-note run returns 'skipped' with no audit row, though the provider now holds a second document.
findings.fix: In record()/recordCredit(): not recorded and the recorded id differs from this answer → claim_lost (audit + log).

findings.what: The public build's _redirects answers 39 old card-id paths that name a supplier (-cj-, zendrop, aliexpress) with a 301; the site was never public, so nothing links to them.
findings.fix: Leave the card-id redirects out of the public build (or keep only ids without a supplier).

findings.what: A second cancellation through the API while a request waits asks the supplier again and writes a second order.cancel_requested row (the screen hides the button; the S13 README says it is not sent twice).
findings.fix: A cancellation already 'requested' with shipments cancel_requested returns its state without calling the supplier.

findings.severity: medium, before the warm-modern house goes public (not HD_PUBLIC=1)
findings.what: The WebP fallback poster (near-lossless 60) weighs 2,859 KB at 2720: a phone without AVIF entering the warm-modern house loads ~3.98 MB, over the 3 MB budget; check-budget measures AVIF only.
findings.fix: Per the ruling: a lossy WebP for the fallback (e.g. q95, 669 KB at 2720, no visible defect at ×1) and the engine on idle in browsers without AVIF; a no-AVIF row in check-budget.

findings.what: The 'no lazy page in the room entry' guard checks chunk file names only: the order page imported statically passes (56.3 KB, no Order- chunk, exit 0).
findings.fix: Check by content: Vite's manifest (the entry's static imports must not include pages/{Order,Checkout,Cart,Product,Legal,MockPay}.tsx), or a marker string per page.
